# list

List plugin trace logs with optional filtering

## Usage

```
ppds plugin-traces list [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--async-only` |  | `bool` |  | Show only asynchronous traces |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `Guid?` |  | Filter by correlation ID |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--entity` |  | `string` |  | Filter by primary entity (contains) |
| `--environment` | `-e` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--errors-only` |  | `bool` |  | Show only traces with exceptions |
| `--filter` |  | `FileInfo` |  | JSON file with filter criteria |
| `--last-24h` |  | `bool` |  | Show traces from the last 24 hours |
| `--last-hour` |  | `bool` |  | Show traces from the last hour |
| `--max-duration` |  | `int?` |  | Maximum execution duration in milliseconds |
| `--message` | `-m` | `string` |  | Filter by message name (Create, Update, etc.) |
| `--min-duration` |  | `int?` |  | Minimum execution duration in milliseconds |
| `--mode` |  | `string` |  | Filter by execution mode: sync or async |
| `--order-by` |  | `string` |  | Sort field (default: createdon desc) |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--record` |  | `string` |  | Filter by record (format: entity or entity/guid, e.g., account or account/12345678-...) |
| `--recursive` |  | `bool` |  | Show only nested traces (depth &gt; 1) |
| `--request-id` |  | `Guid?` |  | Filter by request ID |
| `--since` |  | `DateTime?` |  | Show traces created after this time (ISO 8601) |
| `--step-id` |  | `Guid?` |  | Filter by plugin step ID |
| `--success-only` |  | `bool` |  | Show only successful traces (no exceptions) |
| `--top` | `-n` | `int` |  | Maximum number of results to return |
| `--type` | `-t` | `string` |  | Filter by plugin type name (contains) |
| `--until` |  | `DateTime?` |  | Show traces created before this time (ISO 8601) |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
